spec.goal: Ensure GET /tasks/:id returns HTTP 404 with {"error":"task_not_found"} when the requested task does not exist, without changing unrelated behavior.
requirements: For a GET request whose pathname matches /tasks/:id, look up the task by the captured id via TaskService.get.
If no task exists for that id, return status 404 and body exactly { error: "task_not_found" }.
If the task exists, preserve the existing 200 response containing the task.
Preserve all other route behavior, including the generic 404 response for unmatched routes and the existing create, list, complete, and reopen behavior.
constraints: Use the existing HttpResponse shape and TaskService lookup behavior.
Scope the change to the GET task-by-id path; do not alter unrelated endpoints or error contracts.
Tests are read-only for this task.
nonGoals: Changing task storage, ID generation, or task serialization.
Changing behavior for POST /tasks/:id/complete or POST /tasks/:id/reopen.
Changing list filtering, creation validation, or generic routing errors.
acceptance: GET /tasks/missing (or any nonexistent task id) returns status 404.
The response body for a nonexistent task is exactly { error: "task_not_found" }.
GET /tasks/:id for an existing task still returns status 200 and that task.
verification: Run the repository test suite with npm test; the existing GET /tasks/:id missing-task test must pass along with all other tests.
Review the route handler to confirm the task lookup is checked before returning the existing-task response and that no unrelated route branches changed.
